notes: The supplied *when* of *And when I looked* was marked `added` although the waw וָ of וָאֶרְאֶה stands in the very clause the ASV subordinates. Rule 55 licenses `added` only for a clause with no conjunction in it at all, and the corpus aligns a waw to the two-word connective *and when* in 27 units, *so that* in 38 and *and that* in 8. The waw now takes both English words in one contiguous unit. This also removes the chapter's only inconsistency in its treatment of supplied English: 2.2 fuses כַּאֲשֶׁר into *when*, 2.3 folds *even* into עַד, 2.7 folds *most* into מְרִי, and this verse now folds *when* into the waw that licenses it.
